warning.titlePre: Land Rover Freelander Si4 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The Ford EcoBoost is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford EcoBoost V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford EcoBoost rebuild.
Because the Freelander Si4 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Freelander 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established Ford EcoBoost specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
